description: This file defines an authentication service and user data model for a Flutter-based frontend app, handling user login, logout, registration, and session persistence, with support for mock and real modes.

classes.name: AuthUser
classes.description: Data model representing an authenticated user's profile with id, name, and email.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Service class managing authentication state, session persistence, and mock/real login/register operations.

methods.name: AuthService.create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate AuthService with configuration based on environment variables.

methods.name: AuthService.hasToken
methods.description: Checks if an authentication token is stored, indicating a logged-in session.

methods.name: AuthService.getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the stored user profile if available.

methods.name: AuthService.logout
methods.description: Removes all session-related data from persistent storage.

methods.name: AuthService.login
methods.description: Performs login; returns mock user or throws if real implementation is pending.

methods.name: AuthService.register
methods.description: Performs user registration; returns mock user or throws if real implementation is pending.

methods.name: AuthService.requestPasswordReset
methods.description: Simulates password reset request; intended for real backend integration.

methods.name: _persistSession
methods.description: Internal method to save user session data persistently.
